cards.name: Soundwave, Sonic Spy // Soundwave, Superior Captain

question: Does More Than Meets the Eye work from any zone the spell can be cast from?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: it means you may cast the card converted by paying its cost, and it works in any zone the spell can be cast from.
expected.answer: "More Than Meets the Eye [cost]" means "You may cast this card converted by paying [cost] rather than its mana cost." It functions in any zone from which the spell can be cast.
